notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md in full. The skill explains distributed tracing concepts, Jaeger (Operator and Docker Compose) and Grafana Tempo setup, OpenTelemetry instrumentation in Python/Node.js/Go, context propagation, sampling and Jaeger queries.

Medium: references/details.md:30-52 has the agent create a namespace, apply the Jaeger Operator manifest straight from a GitHub release URL (pinned to v1.51.0) and apply a Jaeger CR with ingress enabled to the user's Kubernetes cluster. Acceptable because it is a version-pinned upstream manifest for a cluster the user is setting up, nothing is deleted or weakened, and the rest is sample code and configuration.

The Jaeger exporters used in the samples (opentelemetry.exporter.jaeger, @opentelemetry/exporter-jaeger, go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/jaeger) are deprecated/removed upstream in favour of OTLP; users should switch to OTLP exporters. Related skills (prometheus-configuration, grafana-dashboards, slo-implementation) are named as optional reading only.
